question: Where can I get a list of hydrogen production projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No single list gives stage and date for electrolysis projects in permitting. DOE Record 24001 (May 2024) lists 43 planned rows without developers or dates; stage, developer and MW come from dockets: Lancaster Clean Energy Center (CEQA approval 2024-03-11, 400 MWe) and Plug Power's Graham, Texas project (DOE FONSI 2025-01-10, twelve 10 MW; agreed for sale July 2026). DOE hub pages are hub-level and stale; the PNWH2 award was reported rescinded in October 2025.
main_caveats: DOE Record 24001 is dated May 2024: it lists Graham, TX as Planned/Under Construction although Plug Power agreed in July 2026 to sell that project; it has no developer or stage date.
A DOE FONSI (Graham, 2025-01-10) and a CEQA approval (Lancaster, 2024-03-11) are not financing, construction or operation: no building or start-of-construction document was found for either.
MW bases differ: 120 MW of electrolyzers, 45 tpd of hydrogen and 164 MW of grid interconnection describe Graham; Lancaster's '400 MWe' is undefined. None converts into another.
DOE hub pages predate the 2025 cuts (Canary Media: awards to two hubs rescinded) and show no electrolyzer-level project, MW or permit; DOE's EIS-0571 dates are anticipated only.
Only California and Texas dockets were opened; Washington, Oregon and other state portals and the IEA project file (account required) were not checked.
answer.confidence_reason: Two projects were traced from portal and DOE documents to dated stages and DOE's table counts reconcile, but no hub project was matched to a docket and most projects, states and the IEA file were not checked.

attributes.note: Lancaster CA (parcels, cross streets) and Graham TX (2264 FM 209) are documented to address level; DOE Table 1 gives city and state for planned rows; no list has coordinates.
attributes.gap_note: Only two projects were traced to site documents; hub projects and other states' dockets were not opened.

attributes.note: Lancaster 400 MWe of electrolyzers; Graham twelve 10 MW units (45 tpd, a separate measure); DOE gives kW for 43 planned rows. Hub documents give tons per day only.
attributes.gap_note: Basis of DOE's kW and of Lancaster's 'MWe' not defined; capacity for other projects was not checked.

attributes.note: Element New Energy Lancaster 1, LLC (Lancaster) and Plug Power (Graham) are named in dockets; DOE Table 1 omits developers and hub pages name consortia.
attributes.gap_note: Developers of the other 41 planned rows and of hub projects were not identified.

attributes.note: Lancaster: CEQA approval (MND) 2024-03-11. Graham: DOE FONSI 2025-01-10, work paused since Dec 2023, sale agreed July 2026. DOE's statuses are only Planned/Under Construction.
attributes.gap_note: No national stage field; hub projects have no site-specific review yet; construction status of Lancaster after March 2024 was not verified.

attributes.note: Dated events for two projects: Lancaster NOD 2024-03-12 (approved 03-11); Graham EA public comment from 2024-12-06, FONSI 2025-01-10, sale release 2026-07-13.
attributes.gap_note: No list gives stage dates; DOE Record 24001 has none; EIS-0571 dates are anticipated.
